title: Building a Sustainable Psychological Life: Habit, Meaning, Seeking Help
summary: Psychological well-being is not merely the absence of illness, but rather: (1) Daily habits: 7-9 hours of sleep, 30 minutes of movement, real food, real connection. (2) Meaning: Discover what gives you purpose (service, knowledge, art, family) — meaning protects from emptiness. (3) Professional network: A therapist/counselor you trust, a psychiatrist whose number you know, and the hotline 937 saved in your contacts. (4) Seeking help is strength: "I need help" is maturity, not weakness. You are building a life, not just passing through a phase.
try_this: This week: Create a "self-contract" — 3 daily habits, one value you live by, a person you trust, and an emergency number. Sign it, and review it monthly.
reflection_prompts: What are the three habits you have committed to?
What value have you chosen to live by in the coming year?
